purpose: PART B + PART C — minimal semantic classification fixture set. Defines raw text + expected epistemic class for each fixture, and the production path that would be exercised.
hardRule: S03 / S04 / S05 / S08 must NOT become locked.facts (must not be projected to PROJECT_TRUTH_KEYS.LOCKED_FACTS with authority=LOCKED).

expected.conflictRisk: low — if project.json brand.name matches, no conflict. If mismatched, identity_mismatch (correct behavior).

fixtures.productionPath: EXTRACTION_SYSTEM_PROMPT field brandName → normalizeExtractedContext.brandName → adaptDocumentVisualContext → PROJECT_TRUTH_KEYS.BRAND_NAME (truthClass=fact, authority=AUTHORITATIVE_DOCUMENT_FACT)

expected.conflictRisk: low — should match project.json's LOCKED locked.facts (Logo Locked) if present. If mismatched, locked_value_violation (correct behavior).

fixtures.productionPath: EXTRACTION_SYSTEM_PROMPT field lockedFacts → normalizeExtractedContext lists.lockedFacts → adaptDocumentVisualContext → PROJECT_TRUTH_KEYS.LOCKED_FACTS (authority=LOCKED, truthClass=user_requirement)

fixtures.rawText: 希望整体视觉更专业理性

expected.conflictRisk: MEDIUM — production has no explicit rule preventing '希望 ...' statements from being placed into lockedFacts. G02.002 evidence (ci-w1c-attempt-2) shows the model can put '希望' content into lockedFacts when the brief also contains '保持' / '一致' / '稳定' language.

fixtures.productionPath: EXTRACTION_SYSTEM_PROMPT has no explicit rule mapping 希望/想要 to visualPreferences. Model decides — production behavior is non-deterministic across brief contexts.

fixtures.rawText: 希望强调全链生态平台的协同关系

expected.conflictRisk: HIGH — same G02.002 trigger pattern. Wording '希望...协同' + brief context '保持...一致' triggers model to put into lockedFacts. G02.002 produced locked.facts = ['信息层级作为包装触点稳定DNA', '不同包装使用同一套信息架构但允许密度差异', '现有品牌资产激活', '跨媒介一致'] from a brief with '希望...保持...贯穿触点...一致' language.

fixtures.productionPath: EXTRACTION_SYSTEM_PROMPT has no explicit rule mapping 希望+协同 to requiredTouchpoints. Model decides — production behavior non-deterministic.

fixtures.rawText: 可以探索网络化视觉语言

expected.conflictRisk: LOW — '可以探索' is a soft suggestion, model is less likely to put into lockedFacts. But production has no explicit guard.

fixtures.productionPath: EXTRACTION_SYSTEM_PROMPT has no explicit rule for 可以探索 / 或许. Model decides.

fixtures.rawText: 行业可能属于医美服务

expected.conflictRisk: MEDIUM — production EXTRACTION_SYSTEM_PROMPT has no explicit 'with hedging markers → model_inference' rule. Model may put into industry as fact (truthClass=fact, authority=AUTHORITATIVE_DOCUMENT_FACT).

fixtures.productionPath: EXTRACTION_SYSTEM_PROMPT allows industry as a fact field. No epistemic-class discrimination for '可能' / '似乎'.

fixtures.rawText: 品牌名称必须保持为一剂良方

expected.extractedField: lockedFacts (because '必须保持' is a lock signal)
expected.conflictRisk: expected behavior — must produce locked_value_violation if project.json brand.name is a different carrier. Note: in Attempt 2 evidence, S07-class content actually goes to brandName AND to locked.facts depending on model.

fixtures.productionPath: EXTRACTION_SYSTEM_PROMPT — model decides based on '必须保持' / '保持' language. May go to brandName OR to lockedFacts. This is itself a risk for production: brand identity info should be FACT (brandName), not LOCKED_RULE (locked.facts).

fixtures.rawText: 空间氛围希望更具疗愈感

expected.conflictRisk: LOW-MEDIUM — '空间氛围...希望' is contextual preference. Model could put in brandPersonality / visualPreferences (correct) or in lockedFacts (incorrect).

fixtures.productionPath: EXTRACTION_SYSTEM_PROMPT has no explicit rule for 希望+atmosphere to visualPreferences. Model decides.
